chapter: Records, Lovie Austin and a first marriage
title: Tommy Ladnier, close friend of Lovie
summary: Tommy Ladnier recorded with her; he and Lovie were close and he went to Europe with Sam Wooding in 1925.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: That was with Lovie, and I noticed on the -- one of the Lovie's that you're on, Tommy Ladnier --
That's another thing I thought about when I was home. Tommy Ladnier did another recording with me.
Yes, now, wasn't Tommy Ladnier, they were very close, weren't they?
Lovie and Tom -- because I remember Lovie talking about him.
Yes, they were extremely close, very good friends.
Uh-huh. And he went, of course, with Sam Wooding, in 1925 to Europe.
That's right, to Europe, uh-huh. He was -- he became very popular in Europe too, Tommy did.
